cli.description: Forense-Framework: Windows digital forensics with chain of custody.
cli.epilog:
Typical workflow:
  forense new ./case01 -n "Intrusion" -i "Analyst"
  forense -c ./case01 evidence add D:\triage\HOST01 --copy
  forense -c ./case01 triage EV-001
  forense -c ./case01 findings
  forense -c ./case01 report --verify
  forense web -w .

Commands also have Spanish aliases (nuevo, evidencia agregar, triaje, hallazgos, informe...).
